kurzbeschreibung: The **Kaunertal** is Tirol’s quiet side – a high valley with a glacier ski area, deep gorges, and authentic alpine farming.
beschreibung: The **Kaunertal** is a quiet, 28-kilometer-long side valley of the Upper Inn Valley and belongs to the most original regions of Tirol. The **Kaunertaler Gletscher** (Weißseeferner) offers skiing up to June at heights of up to 3,110 meters. In summer, the **Kaunertaler Gletscherweg**, an easy high-alpine hike, and the breathtaking **gorge "Walschensaal"** near Feichten attract visitors. The valley is known for its extensive farming and the **Kaunergrat**, which separates it from the Pitztal.
tipps: Die Kaunertaler Gletscherstraße ist eine der höchsten mautpflichtigen Straßen Österreichs (4,50 €).
Der Naturpark Kaunergrat bietet geführte Touren und Schutzhütten mit regionaler Küche.
Der Gletscherparkplatz ist bis ca. 10:00 Uhr noch gut erreichbar.
empfehlungen: Our tip: Hike the Gletscherweg Kaunertal – a family-friendly high-altitude trail with breathtaking views of the Weißseeferner. Afterwards, stop by the Verpeilalm for homemade Kaiserschmarrn.
umgebung: The **Kaunertal** is bordered to the east by the **Kaunergrat** to the **Pitztal**, while to the west lies the **Oberinntal** with the municipality of **Prutz**. To the north, it meets the **Alpenhauptkamm** (Ötztaler Alps). The nearest city is **Landeck** in the **Oberinntal**. The **Reschenpass** to Italy is about 45 km away.
